---
title: "Lightbox: margin figure"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/8697.qmd (#8697): wrapping a
# margin image in a lightbox link must not lose its margin placement.
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-0.png"] > img.column-margin'
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'class="quarto-figure quarto-figure-center column-margin">[\s\S]{0,100}?a href="images/mv-0\.png" class="lightbox"'
        - []
---
